title: Loss of survival follow-up after adverse-event-related treatment discontinuation in single-arm and externally controlled glioblastoma trials: simulation code and review data
description: Code, scenario definitions, true values and performance tables for a simulation study of bias from loss of survival follow-up at adverse-event-related treatment discontinuation in single-arm and externally controlled glioblastoma trials, with a coded review of reporting in 55 published single-arm phase II or I/II high-grade glioma trials.
